name: Premium Frontend
description: From a short brief to a polished React interface with React Bits animations.
why: Give a React interface a **real visual direction**: the agent picks a style that fits the brief, adds interactions, then reviews the result on desktop and mobile.

examples.title: Showcase site
examples.input:
Use `$premium-frontend-skill` to build
a website for a ceramics studio, with
expressive interactions and a polished mobile view.
examples.output: The agent proposes a direction (palette, type, mood), picks a few animated components, builds the site, then reviews it on desktop and mobile.

examples.title: Calm dashboard
examples.input:
Use `$premium-frontend-skill` to
rework our orders dashboard.
Subtle animations only.
examples.output: Same process, with short, stable transitions: readability comes before effects.
